title: Long ant, placed on the played bed
question: Does the long-bodied ant (the articulated body, now a species you place rather than the shipped ant) read as one animal with a long body -- forage, wander, and turn round -- rather than a smear of loose cells?
context_md: The shipped colony still starts as the two-cell ant. This is `longant`, placed on the owner's own played bed (`played_bed_longant.ron`) via the same `Colony` timeline event, with the flip (turn round in a dead end) on by default. Camera centred near the nest at (265,145), zoom 5x, frames 8,300-9,500.
